core_test_suites.description: Covers 13 comprehensive uncertainty, margin aggregation, GPS, and calibration scenarios
12 test methods covering leakage isolation, author grouping, unknown monuments, and corruptions
16 test methods covering multi-scale region proposals, SIFT, ORB, and geometric verification
12 integration scenarios for Tier 2 Gemini VLM, schemas, telemetry, and fallback
10 grounded knowledge tests for ASI/UNESCO citation registers and Q&A grounding

auxiliary_test_suites.description: Legacy base API endpoint integration tests (not part of the 5 canonical engine suites)
FAISS vector count and dimension sanity check (standalone utility)

reconciliation_summary.discrepancy_explanation: No tests were deleted, renamed, or modified. In Phase 8.2D, the auditor made reporting errors: counting 5 states in test_uncertainty instead of the 13 scenarios, and under-counting sub-tests in calibration and local features. Running pytest or unittest across the entire suite confirms 63 core engine tests and 10 auxiliary integration tests, 100% passing.
